summary: Calm 5,700px page under a short photo band: intro line, a 'why outsource' split with three accordion tiles, six benefit cards, a three-step journey with photo, a green quote card, a partner-choice split, five reasons, FAQ and a green closing block. Same skeleton for payroll, bookkeeping and year-end.

sections.note: a wide dark photo band (a conference crowd) with a darkened overlay; the title sits centered in a small green label box with dark text. No lead, no button, no breadcrumb. The page body starts right under the band.
centered heading and a grey paragraph, about 160px tall
heading, a paragraph and a bullet list left; three lilac accordion tiles right (each with an icon and a closed chevron) that expand to a short paragraph
centered heading and a grey line, then six pale green cards (3 by 2) each with a line icon, a green title and two lines
centered heading and one line; below, a photo left and three stacked pale lilac accordion tiles right (step 1 discovery call, step 2 recommendation, next steps), each with a line icon and chevron
a pale green rounded quote card, centered, with a big quote mark and one sentence (no name)
short heading, paragraphs and a text link left; a rounded photo (people at an event) right
grey band: centered heading, five columns each with a small green star mark, a bold title and a short paragraph
grey band: heading and one line at the left, five or six white question rows at the right with a chevron
a big rounded green block (not full width) with a heading at the left and one black button
